diane: quick async check — we're changing the /v1/generate contract for stop handling + logprobs. two quick Qs:
1) if a stop sequence is matched mid-token during streaming, do we guarantee the returned text excludes the partial token and that logprobs don't include the partial token?
2) if max_tokens is hit at the same time as a stop match, which should appear as termination_reason?

chao: short answer: runtime currently finalizes at token boundary. if a stop is detected that spans token boundaries we discard the partial match and do not emit that partial token in the final output. logprobs are returned only for fully emitted tokens. so partial-token matches are not present in logprobs.

maria: fyi from eng-runtime — we're landing an explicit termination field on responses: `termination_reason` with values like `stop` / `max_tokens` / `cancel`. PR #6789 contains implementation + tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6789

maria: also plan to include a `truncated` boolean for whether the last emitted token was truncated due to stop detection at byte/utf8 boundary (rare). streaming clients will get a final delta with `type: done` and the termination_reason in the last message.

chao: proposal for API contract: keep it simple now — `termination_reason` + `truncated:true|false`. avoid freeform detail strings. clients that need more can check logs.

maria: implementation note: computing `logprobs` for sampling with top_p/temp is expensive — we'll only attach `logprobs` when `logprobs` param > 0 and cap returned items to 10 tokens to limit payload size. this should be documented in the contract.

infra-bot: canary deploy started for runtime v2.3 in us-west-2 (10% nodes). PR 6789 included in canary. status: deploy_in_progress -> healthy_on_canary.

diane: perfect, i'll update the API contract doc (docs/api/generate.md) with the new fields and an example. adding a small example response for clarity:
```json
{"id":"gen_01","text":"Hello","termination_reason":"stop","truncated":false,"logprobs":[-0.23,-1.1]}
```
assigning @chao for CR on the docs + short note to SDK teams. thanks :thumbsup:

chao: noted — I'll review the doc + PR tomorrow morning. one thing to confirm: streaming clients should receive a final `{"type":"done","reason":"stop"}` delta. runtime will emit that as last message. ok from my side.

maria: agreed. will add unit tests to assert `last_message` delta contains termination_reason.

diane: awesome, closing loop here. thanks everyone!
